operator_config.name: experimentalDefaultEncodeProfile
operator_config.doc:
experimentalDefaultEncodeProfile is the hardcoded scheduling profile that
selects encode-stage endpoints. In E/PD disaggregation the encode and
decode stages run as separate profiles; this matches the
disagg-profile-handler default. Hardcoded until plugins can identify
profile roles canonically (see https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-router/issues/1091).

operator_config.name: P2PSourcePluginType
operator_config.doc: P2PSourcePluginType is the registered type name of the p2p-source-producer.

operator_config.name: costMarginNone
operator_config.doc: costMarginNone labels a decision the cost model did not price.

operator_config.name: PluginType
operator_config.doc: PluginType is the registered type name of the p2p-source-producer.

operator_config.name: cpuDeviceTier
operator_config.doc:
cpuDeviceTier is the CachedBlocksByTier key for the CPU tier (device tiers
are lowercased by the KV-event pipeline).

operator_config.name: decisionStateKey
operator_config.doc: decisionStateKey keys the decision PreRequest stores for ResponseBody.

operator_config.name: defaultP2PConnectorPort
operator_config.doc:
defaultP2PConnectorPort is the port of the vLLM OffloadingConnector P2P
tier on data parallel rank 0; rank r listens on defaultP2PConnectorPort+r.

operator_config.name: defaultPrefillProfile
operator_config.doc:
defaultPrefillProfile is the disaggregation prefill profile name; when
that profile's result carries an endpoint, that endpoint computes the
prefix. Operators who rename it (disagg-profile-handler profiles.prefill)
must set prefillProfileName to match.

operator_config.name: prefixMetricsPrefillProfile
operator_config.doc:
prefixMetricsPrefillProfile is the prefill profile name the prefix-cache
prediction metrics read. endpoint_role uses it, not prefillProfileName, so
both metric families give a request the same role.

operator_config.name: PluginType
operator_config.doc: PluginType is the registered type name of the precise-prefix-cache-producer.

operator_config.name: LatencyDataProviderPluginType
operator_config.doc: LatencyDataProviderPluginType is the default producer type for LatencyPredictionInfoDataKey.

operator_config.name: ErrResponseLengthMismatch
operator_config.value: errors.New("bulk prediction count does not match request count")
operator_config.doc:
ErrResponseLengthMismatch indicates that the prediction server returned a
different number of predictions than requested.

operator_config.name: ObjectiveQuantile
operator_config.doc: ObjectiveType constants for prediction objective.

operator_config.name: ExperimentalDefaultPrefillProfile
operator_config.doc: ExperimentalDefaultPrefillProfile is the default profile name for prefill endpoints in disaggregated serving.

operator_config.name: LatencyDataProviderPluginType
operator_config.doc:
LatencyDataProviderPluginType is the plugin type for the latency predictor.
It trains XGBoost models via the sidecar and generates predictions for scoring.

operator_config.name: TPOTSLOHeaderKey
operator_config.doc: TPOTSLOHeaderKey is the header key for the TPOT SLO.

operator_config.name: TTFTSLOHeaderKey
operator_config.doc: TTFTSLOHeaderKey is the header key for the TTFT SLO.

operator_config.name: GPUMissFiltered
operator_config.doc: GPUMissFiltered tokens were in the GPU memory of an endpoint a filter removed.

operator_config.name: GPUMissLowerTier
operator_config.doc:
GPUMissLowerTier tokens were in no endpoint's GPU memory and in a lower
device tier of the chosen endpoint.

operator_config.name: GPUMissNotPicked
operator_config.doc:
GPUMissNotPicked tokens were in the GPU memory of an endpoint that reached
the picker and was not chosen.

operator_config.name: GPUMissPeerLowerTier
operator_config.doc:
GPUMissPeerLowerTier tokens were in no endpoint's GPU memory and only in a
lower device tier of another endpoint.

operator_config.name: GPUMissUncached
operator_config.doc: GPUMissUncached tokens were confirmed on no endpoint.

operator_config.name: modalityLabelHelp
operator_config.value: The modality label holds the request's carried modalities as a comma-joined sorted list (none for text-only, other for anything but image, audio and video); each request is observed once.

operator_config.name: SessionIDProducerType
operator_config.doc: SessionIDProducerType is the default producer type for SessionIDDataKey.

operator_config.name: SessionIDProducerType

operator_config.doc:
maxEstimatedPromptTokens bounds the token stream that multimodal placeholders
may grow a request to. Placeholder counts come from client-declared values
(image headers, x-llm-d-video-* and x-llm-d-audio-* headers), so without a

value is above the context window of current multimodal models, so it only
affects requests the model server would reject anyway.

operator_config.name: renderFailureLogInterval
operator_config.doc:
renderFailureLogInterval bounds the render failure log to one line per
interval per plugin instance. A saturated render endpoint fails every
request, and the metrics carry the per-request signal.

operator_config.name: defaultAudioBytesPerSecond
operator_config.doc:

that are not PCM WAV, modeling ~128kbps compressed audio.

operator_config.name: defaultAudioTokensPerSecond
operator_config.doc:

configuration; this is only the no-config fallback.

operator_config.name: defaultImageWidth
operator_config.doc:

operator_config.doc:
defaultPriorityHeaders is the built-in ordered list, always checked. User-

operator_config.name: CodexTurnMetadataHeader
operator_config.doc:
CodexTurnMetadataHeader carries a JSON blob whose session_id field is
the root session identity shared by every thread in the tree. The flat
session-id header is a derived cache-affinity key on root-thread
requests, so the turn metadata is the authoritative Codex session
source.

operator_config.name: DerivedRootKey
operator_config.doc:
DerivedRootKey is the request-attribute key under which this plugin
publishes the derived program root: the session ID of the root request of
the tree the request belongs to. The Director reads it via
scheduling.ReadRequestAttribute to compose the fairness key.
The key carries no producer name: any plugin able to derive a program root
is an acceptable source.

operator_config.name: OpenCodeSessionHeader
operator_config.doc:
OpenCodeSessionHeader carries the request's own session ID. It is not
interchangeable with agentidentity.OpenCodeSessionHeader
(x-session-affinity), which carries the parent one hop up.

operator_config.name: ParentSessionHeader
operator_config.doc:
ParentSessionHeader is the shared wire-convention header carrying the
parent session ID one hop up. OpenCodeParentSessionHeader is
opencode's vendor-specific form of the same link; opencode sends both.

operator_config.name: defaultParentHeaders
operator_config.doc:
defaultParentHeaders is the built-in ordered list of parent-ID headers.
Codex's x-codex-parent-thread-id is deliberately absent: it names a thread
ID while the parent map is keyed by session IDs, and Codex needs no parent
map because the turn-metadata session_id carries the root on every request.

operator_config.name: defaultSessionHeaders
operator_config.doc:
defaultSessionHeaders resolves the request's own session ID, in priority
order. opencode's own-ID header comes first because x-session-affinity
carries the parent one hop up rather than the session's own ID; the
affinity header stays last as a fallback for traffic without the own-ID
header. Codex's turn-metadata header is handled before this list.

operator_config.name: maxTurnMetadataHeaderBytes
operator_config.doc:
maxTurnMetadataHeaderBytes bounds the JSON parse of the turn-metadata
header; larger values are ignored and the session falls back to the
header list.

operator_config.name: maxWalkHops
operator_config.doc:
maxWalkHops bounds a single parent-map walk. Nesting reaches three to
four layers in the harnesses, and a client can chain links up to the
map bound, so the walk stops past this many links and roots at the
current node, keeping the lock hold bounded.

operator_config.name: AttributeKey
operator_config.doc:
AttributeKey is the request-attribute key under which this plugin publishes
the predicted output-length bin. Downstream consumers read it via
scheduling.ReadRequestAttribute[Bucket]. It is a DataKey rather than a plain
string because #2190 keyed the per-request attribute store by DataKey.

(max_output_tokens) strictly below this makes a >=2000-token generation
physically impossible, so it vetoes a tentative LONG classification
(the max_output_tokens "bin ceiling" — purely restrictive, high precision).

operator_config.doc: cacheChosen: the revision with the longest cached prefix was selected.

operator_config.name: cacheMissingMatchInfo

operator_config.doc:
selectionFractionAlpha weighs each selection in the moving average, which
covers roughly the last 1/alpha selections.

operator_config.name: selectionFractionFloor
operator_config.doc:
selectionFractionFloor drops a revision once its fraction decays below it,
so revisions that left the pool do not accumulate.

operator_config.name: AffinityModeNone
operator_config.doc: AffinityModeNone draws every request independently at random.

operator_config.name: AffinityModePrefix
operator_config.doc:
AffinityModePrefix keys weighted rendezvous selection on the first
session identifier resolved from Sources, else the text conversation
prefix. Otherwise PrefixCache, when set, may pick the revision holding
the request's cached prefix, falling back to a random draw.

operator_config.name: DefaultOverflowRole
operator_config.doc: DefaultOverflowRole is the role checked for room by default.

operator_config.name: GatingModeDisabled
operator_config.doc:
GatingModeDisabled turns off revision coverage and weighted selection.
Revision header filtering and response stamping remain enabled.

operator_config.name: GatingModeMaxRole
operator_config.doc:
GatingModeMaxRole applies the same coverage check as GatingModeSum, sums
each required role across every covered revision, and selects the role
with the largest total. Every revision is then weighted by its Ready pod
count for that same role. RequiredRoles order resolves equal totals.

operator_config.name: GatingModeSum
operator_config.doc:
GatingModeSum does two things:
  1. Drop any revision missing Ready pods on any listed role
     (rollout drift safety).
  2. Weighted-random-pick ONE surviving revision, weighted by the
     sum of Ready pod counts across every listed role, and keep
     only that revision's candidates.
Traffic converges on (sum(crossRolePods(rev)) / sum over all
revisions), independent of the picker downstream. The "sum" name
refers to the per-revision sum used as weight.
For A={prefill:2,decode:9} and B={prefill:1,decode:1}, the weights
are 11 and 2, producing shares of 11/13 and 2/13.

map[topoutil.Level]float64{
	topoutil.LevelHost:	1.00,
	topoutil.LevelRack:	0.20,
	topoutil.LevelZone:	0.05,
	topoutil.LevelRegion:	0.02,
	topoutil.LevelNone:	0.00,
}
operator_config.doc:
levelScores maps the tightest common topology level to its proximity
score, shaped by the KV-transfer bandwidth available at that level rather
than by even spacing: same host uses NVLink, same rack a NIC and a single
switch, and each looser level adds switch hops. Host dominates rack 5:1 and
zone 20:1 so co-location wins outright, while the looser levels still carry
enough signal to break ties among non-colocated candidates.

These ratios are hardcoded rather than configurable per level; if a real
deployment shows they are wrong, add per-level weight parameters then.

operator_config.doc:
DestinationEndpointScoresKey is the response metadata key holding a struct that maps each endpoint listed in
DestinationEndpointKey to the scheduler's score for it. Emitted only when the EPP is started with
--emit-endpoint-scores and the picker surfaced scores.

operator_config.name: DestinationEndpointServedKey
operator_config.doc: DestinationEndpointServedKey is the metadata key used by Envoy to specify the endpoint that served the request.

operator_config.name: FairnessIDTenantSeparator
operator_config.doc:
FairnessIDTenantSeparator separates the tenant prefix from the program/session
identity in a composed fairness ID: "<tenant>/<session>". The Director builds such
IDs when requestHandler.composeFairnessIDs is enabled and the request carries a
fairness-ID header (the tenant part); the agent-identity attribute (the session
part) is appended when present. Composition keeps the tenant visible for isolation
and metric labels while flow control keys one queue per session. In a composed ID
the tenant part is percent-encoded: "%" becomes "%25" and the separator becomes

On current main the index identity (kvblock.PodEntry) is pod-level and does

reference counts aggregate across ranks — which is exactly what the pod-level
index requires (a block is still resident on the pod until every rank has
removed it). The value matches PR #370's NoDataParallelRank (-1) convention.

TODO(#370): once DataParallelRank is propagated onto EventBatch and into
PodEntry, source the rank from the event in pool.go so the dedup scope
becomes DP-aware in lockstep with the (then DP-aware) index identity. No
change to this file is required — only the scope construction at the call
sites.

carries no KV-cache group. It mirrors the "no group" PodEntry state

reference-counted independently — matching how the index treats them as
distinct entries. Real event group indices are non-negative (the engine
adapters reject a negative group_idx), so this sentinel cannot collide with a
genuine group.

moriio_dns_reresolve_total, moriio_dns_ip_changed_total, and
moriio_dns_lookup_failures_total.

operator_config.name: errPrefillAborted
operator_config.doc:
errPrefillAborted reports a prefill response whose body failed to arrive
after its status did.

operator_config.name: grpcMethodRoutes
operator_config.doc: grpcMethodRoutes maps served gRPC method paths to their request API types.

operator_config.name: MoRIIOFeatureEnabled
operator_config.doc:
MoRIIOFeatureEnabled controls whether MoRI-IO WRITE-mode and Wide-EP
features are available. Set to false to keep the feature dormant until
full validation and CI integration is complete in a future RC.

When false, any attempt to use --moriio-write-mode or related flags will
fail with a clear error message directing users to wait for the feature
to be officially released.

AMD-MoRI-IO: Feature enabled for 1P1D (DP=EP=8) intra-node Wide-EP
and 2P2D (DP=EP=16) inter-node Wide-EP with LeaderWorkerSet support.

operator_config.name: defaultECMooncakePort
operator_config.doc: defaultECMooncakePort matches the ec_port default of vLLM's ECTransferConfig.

operator_config.name: defaultMoRIIOParallelDecodeWaitTimeout
operator_config.doc:
defaultMoRIIOParallelDecodeWaitTimeout backstops the parallel WRITE
dispatch: it bounds how long the decode request waits on the prefill outcome
(and thus KV) before being cancelled, so a hung/failed prefill fails the
request instead of hanging. Prefill in parallel dispatch is capped to one
token, so it normally resolves well within this window.

operator_config.name: defaultResolveTTL
operator_config.doc:
defaultResolveTTL bounds how long a resolved peer IP is cached before the
next request-time lookup re-resolves it. Kept short so a peer pod that
restarts with a new IP is picked up within one TTL window, but long enough
that steady-state request handling does not perform a DNS lookup per call.

operator_config.name: defaultResolveTimeout
operator_config.doc:
defaultResolveTimeout bounds a single DNS lookup on the request path so a
slow or hanging resolver cannot stall request handling indefinitely. On
timeout the resolver falls back to the last-known-good IP (or the raw spec).

operator_config.name: envMoRIIODNSResolveTTLSeconds
operator_config.doc:
envMoRIIODNSResolveTTLSeconds overrides the peer-IP re-resolution TTL (in
seconds). Operators can widen or tighten the window without a rebuild.

operator_config.name: envMoRIIODNSResolveTimeoutSeconds
operator_config.doc:
envMoRIIODNSResolveTimeoutSeconds overrides the per-lookup DNS timeout (in
seconds). Bounds how long a single request-path resolution may block before
falling back to the last-known-good IP (or the raw spec).

operator_config.name: BundleVersion
operator_config.doc:
BundleVersion is the value used for labeling the CRD bundle version.
Defaults to "main-dev" for development builds. Set via -ldflags at release time via Github workflow.

operator_config.name: BundleVersionAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
BundleVersionAnnotation is the annotation key used in llm-d CRDs to specify
the installed bundle version.

prometheus_metrics.help: Total successful request-path re-resolutions of MoRI-IO peer DNS names.
